method: Static producer analysis: every class under app/Jobs/** was matched by name against all PHP in app/, routes/, config/, database/, bootstrap/ and tests/. A job with references only from tests/ is counted as ZERO_DISPATCH, because a unit test calling handle() directly is not a producer.

closed_by_scheduler.name: player-protection-self-exclusion-expiry
closed_by_scheduler.impact_if_never_run: Self-exclusions never lapse. Regulatory breach in both directions.

closed_by_scheduler.name: player-protection-limit-enforcement
closed_by_scheduler.impact_if_never_run: Deposit, loss and session limits are recorded but never enforced.

closed_by_scheduler.name: player-protection-reality-checks
closed_by_scheduler.impact_if_never_run: Mandated session-time prompts are never shown.

closed_by_scheduler.name: player-protection-case-review
closed_by_scheduler.impact_if_never_run: Escalated protection cases queue up unreviewed.

closed_by_scheduler.name: notification-outbox-drain
closed_by_scheduler.impact_if_never_run: THE OUTBOX IS NEVER DRAINED. No player receives any notification; the table grows without bound.

closed_by_scheduler.name: notification-retry-sweep
closed_by_scheduler.impact_if_never_run: A transient provider failure becomes permanent message loss.

closed_by_scheduler.name: security-session-revocation
closed_by_scheduler.impact_if_never_run: Expired sessions stay usable. Authentication defect.

closed_by_scheduler.name: security-mfa-challenge-expiry
closed_by_scheduler.impact_if_never_run: An MFA challenge never expires, making the second factor replayable.

closed_by_scheduler.name: security-high-risk-review
closed_by_scheduler.impact_if_never_run: High-risk security events are logged and never triaged.

closed_by_scheduler.name: betting-cancellation-window-expiry
closed_by_scheduler.impact_if_never_run: A player's stake sits in limbo past the cancellation window.

closed_by_scheduler.name: reporting-export-retention
closed_by_scheduler.impact_if_never_run: Exports containing personal data are retained indefinitely.

why_the_remainder_is_open: All eleven are event-driven and money- or result-critical: every one of them either moves money or decides a prize outcome. Wiring them requires choosing the exact transaction boundary and the exact operator approval gate, and two of them (DisburseApprovedPrizeJob, ExecutePayoutTransferJob) must sit behind PRIZE_PAYOUT_SAFETY_MODE. Attaching them to a plausible-looking producer without a verified end-to-end settlement test would be guessing with real money. They are reported OPEN rather than closed speculatively.
